reviews.review_text:
Andrea L
Rome, Italy5127 contributions

In the place to end the evening.
Aug 2026 • Couples
The Cloud Sky Bar is a very pleasant rooftop in the heart of the Old Quarter, perfect for taking a break from the chaos of Hanoi's streets and seeing the city from a completely different perspective.

The place is located on the ninth floor of the JM Marvel Hotel and has an outdoor terrace with a beautiful panoramic view over the city's rooftops. The best time in my opinion is around sunset, to see Hanoi slowly change its appearance and light up with the evening lights.

The atmosphere is well-kept and relaxed, pleasant both for an aperitif and for having a drink after dinner. Good selection of cocktails and the staff is very courteous and attentive.

Naturally, the prices are higher compared to the normal bars found on the street in Hanoi, but you are also paying for the location and the experience of having a drink with the city below you.

A nice place to spend an hour in peace, especially if you are looking for something different from the classic beer halls of the Old Quarter. I recommend arriving before sunset to enjoy the view both in the daylight and with Hanoi illuminated. Pay attention because the last drink is at 11:30 PM (but you can stay afterwards) and you can pay with a credit card.
